Sub: Audio recording of earnings call – Q1 FY27 – Financial Results 
 
Dear Ma’am / Sir,

hosted by the Company on July 24, 2026, to discuss the ﬁnancial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Regulations, 2015, the Company has conducted Q1 FY27 Earnings Call today i.e. July 24, 2026, and have 
uploaded the audio recording on the website of the Company which can be accessed at:
